messages:
sara_sales: Novara pushed back the MSA/DPA with several redlines and wants PO + signatures this week. Can legal/procurement triage?

mike_legal: Quick read: they want 99.95% uptime, 10% cap on credits, broader indemnity around customer data, and a 60-day termination-for-convenience.

anita_procurement: Billing asks: invoice to billing@novara.com, PO# required on each invoice, and they requested a W-9. They also asked whether we can accept EFT.

sara_sales: They also asked for a throughput SLA on batch embedding jobs in the DPA. We typically don't include that in MSA. Thoughts?

devin_engineering: For the POC: EU-only (eu-west-1), dedicated tenant, KMS customer-managed keys, no cross-region backups. We can stand it up in ~3 business days. We'll cap concurrent sessions to 5 for the POC.
mike_legal: Counterproposal ideas: keep uptime at 99.9 with tiered credits, remove throughput SLA from MSA (offer via Dedicated order form), limit indemnity to standard carve-outs, and change data portability to 45 days instead of 30.
anita_procurement: For signature routing: Novara needs CFO signature + buyer on DocuSign. Who will originate the envelope? Sales or Legal? Also we need ship-to/bill-to fields on the order form.
sara_sales: I can initiate DocuSign once legal signs counters. Anita, can you confirm the buyer contact and whether they prefer EFT or wire?
anita_procurement: I'll chase the buyer for PO# and W-9. They pref'd EFT but want bank details to be included on the invoice.
secbot: [automated] SOC2 Type II is available: https://internal-share/redwood/soc2/2025-type2.pdf
mike_legal: I'll produce a marked-up PDF with line-by-line accept/alt language today. I'll call out the audit scope and propose SOC2-first plus incident-driven on-site audits.
devin_engineering: Also feeding into legal: POC resource doc will include limits (concurrent sessions=5, vCPU/GPU quota details) and data handling checklist so there's no mismatch.
anita_procurement: Order form note: include PO# field, billing contact, tax ID, remit address, and payment terms (Net30 by default). Novara is pushing Net45; can sales concede?
sara_sales: We typically do Net30. We can offer Net45 for the first year with a slight pricing uplift if leadership approves.
mike_legal: Good. I'll annotate the MSA/DPA and tag acceptable concessions vs blockers. After that, sales can send DocuSign.
anita_procurement: Goal: get PO & signed DocuSign by EOW. I'll keep the thread updated on PO/W-9 status.
sara_sales: Thanks everyone. Next steps: Mike posts counters, Anita confirms PO/W-9 & payment method, Devin uploads POC limits. I'll queue DocuSign after legal OK. Ping here for any change. :thumbsup:
